attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, chowned the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, set dirs to 750 and files to 640 (owner rwx/rw, group r-x/r, others none), preserving all existing file contents. Verified inventorysvc can read the data and an unrelated user (nobody) is denied. Then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native reboot, polled until the node responded again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership, permissions, and data content survived the restart.
